hero.title: Adhiparasakthi Agricultural College
hero.summary: Study agriculture at Kalavai in Ranipet district through a college affiliated to Tamil Nadu Agricultural University. APAC combines a four-year agriculture degree with farm and laboratory learning, including rural work experience. Its audited ICAR entry specifically covers B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture.

overview.heading: An agriculture college at Kalavai
paragraphs: Adhiparasakthi Agricultural College is based at G. B. Nagar in Kalavai, Ranipet district. It is affiliated to Tamil Nadu Agricultural University and focuses on agriculture education, research and rural development. Its learning environment combines academic study with laboratory and farm facilities.

The four-year agriculture degree brings crop, soil and plant-health subjects into practical settings. The published course outline includes rural work experience and skill-based activities, giving applicants specific elements to discuss when comparing colleges. Ask how farm assignments and rural learning are scheduled for the intended cohort, alongside the current entry requirements and full residential or day-scholar costs.

programmes.name: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture
programmes.summary: A four-year degree covering crop production, soil science, plant protection and related agricultural sciences. The official course outline includes practical farm work, rural exposure and Student READY activities.
programmes.eligibility: The undated official course page lists 10+2 or equivalent with Physics, Chemistry and Biology/Botany/Zoology, and also refers to Agricultural Science/Vocational Agriculture streams. Minimum aggregate is subject to applicable admission regulations.
programmes.admission_route: Merit/ranking and the selection guidelines of the affiliated university, as described on the undated course page.

fees.note: A dated official fee schedule with tuition, compulsory charges and residential costs was not verified.

programmes.icar_scope_note: The audited ICAR row covers B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at Adhiparasakthi Agricultural College, Ranipet, Vellore for 2022-03-17 to 2027-03-16. Printed intake is retained in recognition as historical scope.

admissions.heading: Applying through TNAU counselling
admissions.intro: Adhiparasakthi Agricultural College describes an application review followed by counselling or document verification. Its B.Sc. Agriculture page requires the relevant higher-secondary science or vocational agriculture background, while the applicable TNAU rules determine the final qualifying threshold and seat route.
eligibility_points: The course page requires Higher Secondary or an accepted equivalent qualification.
Exact minimum marks follow the applicable admission regulations; no current numerical cutoff was verified.

steps.title: Check the programme and applicable route
steps.text: Confirm the TNAU entry rules for B.Sc. Agriculture and the seat category before using the college form.

steps.title: Submit the college application
steps.text: The college accepts its prescribed application with the relevant supporting documents, online or at the admission office.

steps.title: Complete counselling and verification
steps.text: Shortlisted applicants follow counselling/document-verification instructions; a form submission is not an admission guarantee.

steps.title: Confirm a verified offer
steps.text: Pay the applicable charges and complete registration only after checking the written seat offer and current fee statement.

documents: Aadhaar card or another valid identity document
Originals for verification and application photocopies
admissions.route_scope: These steps describe the TNAU counselling channel. Any separate college-management route must be checked independently.

campus.heading: From crop science to village experience
campus.intro: The official degree page identifies demonstration farms, research plots and crop-protection teaching facilities. Its practical curriculum includes field diagnostics and rural interaction; these are programme descriptions rather than measured student outcomes.

facilities.name: Farm facilities
facilities.description: The college describes farm-based teaching alongside academic study.

facilities.name: Laboratories
facilities.description: The degree page identifies seed-testing and crop-protection laboratories.

practical_learning: Rural Agricultural Work Experience is listed as a curriculum component involving village and farmer interaction.
Student READY is described through internships, skill modules and experiential units.

scholarships.heading: Scholarships and financial support
scholarships.text: A current agriculture-specific scholarship schedule for APAC was not verified. Request the scheme name, funding authority, category rules, renewal conditions and net payable amount in writing before relying on a concession.

placements.heading: Career support and outcomes
placements.text: The course page outlines possible agricultural, banking, research and enterprise careers. These are potential pathways, not evidence of APAC graduate placement. A dated programme-level recruitment or salary report was not verified.

recognition.heading: Recognition and programme accreditation

faqs.question: Where is APAC located?
faqs.answer: The college lists G. B. Nagar, Kalavai, in Ranipet district, Tamil Nadu.

faqs.question: Is this the agricultural or horticultural college?
faqs.answer: This profile concerns Adhiparasakthi Agricultural College; the wider website also presents a separate horticultural college.

faqs.question: How long is the agriculture degree?
faqs.answer: The official B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture page specifies four years.

faqs.question: What practical components are described?
faqs.answer: The published outline includes farm work, RAWE and Student READY activities. Ask for the current timetable and allocation of practical hours.

faqs.question: What does the ICAR entry cover?
faqs.answer: The audited row covers B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture from 17 March 2022 to 16 March 2027.

faqs.question: What entry qualification is published for APAC?
faqs.answer: The undated official course page lists 10+2 or equivalent with Physics, Chemistry and Biology/Botany/Zoology, and also refers to Agricultural Science/Vocational Agriculture streams. Minimum aggregate is subject to applicable admission regulations.

faqs.question: Which named academic staff are listed for APAC?
faqs.answer: APAC publishes a teaching-employee directory with qualifications. The selection below preserves its general teaching-faculty classification; individual professorial ranks and department assignments are not inferred. Dr. P. Kalaiselvan — Teaching faculty — Ph.D.; Ms. K. Sivasakthi — Teaching faculty — M.Sc. Agriculture; NET; Dr. C. Navinkumar — Teaching faculty — Ph.D..

faqs.question: Which application documents are listed for APAC?
faqs.answer: Higher-secondary/12 th marksheet for UG applicants; Transfer certificate; Community certificate where applicable; Conduct/character certificate; Recent passport-size photographs; Aadhaar card or another valid identity document; Originals for verification and application photocopies. Match these to the official requirements for your chosen programme and quota.

faqs.question: Which university is named as the affiliating institution for APAC?
faqs.answer: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University, Coimbatore is the affiliating institution named in this profile.

faqs.question: Where is the official application information for APAC?
faqs.answer: https://www.apachc.in/ac/admission-procedure.html. Read the programme, campus and applicable intake instructions on this official channel.
